Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in Step 14 by misinterpreting the ISO 8601 UTC timestamp (`+1975-08-08T00:00:00Z`) found in the Wikipedia metadata (Wikidata) as requiring conversion to the local timezone (America/New_York). The Planner incorrectly calculated that `1975-08-08 00:00:00 UTC` converts to `1975-08-07 20:00:00 EDT` and subsequently claimed the "real-world local date" (August 7, 1975) was the authoritative birthday, overriding the explicit text on the Wikipedia page which states "August 8, 1975". This timezone conversion logic is fundamentally flawed for extracting a birth date, as the date stored in such databases is already the local date of birth, and converting a midnight UTC timestamp to local time results in a date shift that does not represent the actual calendar date of birth. This error propagated to the final answer, changing the correct date (August 8, 1975) to the incorrect date (August 7, 1975).
